name: Heightened Excitations
body:
Your blood energy can magnify your spellcasting prowess.

Prerequisite(s): Arcane excitation class feature, Heighten Spell

Benefit(s): When you cast a spell affected by the Heighten Spell metamagic while in a bloodrage you may forgo gaining blood points from eldritch elation to increase your caster level and its effective spell level by 1. (This stacks with the increase from Heighten Spell.)
